## Kaplan–Meier Survival Analysis

We estimated survival curves using the Kaplan–Meier estimator.

```r
fit_km <- survfit(Surv_EFS ~ gene_fusion, data = my_data)
```

The survival curves were visualized using `survminer`.

```r
ggsurvplot(fit_km)
```
